summary: Apply Promo button overlaps Submit Order button on mobile checkout page
preconditions: User has items in the cart and is on the checkout page at mobile viewport width below 768px.
steps_to_reproduce: Open Chrome DevTools and set device dimensions to 390 x 844
Scroll down to the promo code and order summary section
expected_result: Apply Promo and Submit Order buttons are properly spaced and do not overlap.
actual_result: Apply Promo visually overlaps Submit Order, completely blocking the submit control.
